messages:
elena: Spectra asked for a short owner list and minimal run script for next week's perf/W validation. Can folks claim pieces? cc @samir @jin @marcos

samir: I got kernels. I will build two variants: stock and nvlink-priority. Will add perf-event list and build SHA. ETA Mon morning.

jin: I will push two images: runtime:3.0-spectra and runtime:3.0-quant. Ill include bench_wrapper.sh that emits JSON results. Target seqs: 512, 2048; batches: 1, 4.

marcos: Telemetry + matrix: Ill create SPECTRA-<RUNID>-matrix.csv fields (run_id,model,kernel,image,seq,batch,pstate,capped,wall_meter). Ill also collect BIOS power cap screenshot.

elena: Run modes: controlled-pstate (partner recommended) and uncapped burst. Metrics: gpu power (nvidia-smi), wall power, tokens/sec, p95 latency, KV cache hit. No public numbers until joint approval.

samir: Kernel build snippet for repo:
```bash
make -j12 MODE=release KERNEL_TUNE=nvlink_priority
git rev-parse --short HEAD > /results/kernel_sha.txt
```

jin: Run snippet Ill include:
```bash
export RUN_ID=SPECTRA-2026-06-10-01
docker run --rm --gpus all -e RUN_ID -e SEQ=2048 -e BATCH=1 -v /results:/results ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:3.0-spectra ./bench_wrapper.sh --model gptj --tokens 80000
```

marcos: ops-bot: please confirm rack booking.

ops-bot: Rack SPECTRA-RACK-9 booked Thu 09:00-17:00. Ticket SPC-3311.

elena: Good. Owners: samir=kernels, jin=images+harness, marcos=matrix+telemetry, elena=comms+runbook. Please upload artifacts to gs://redwood-spectra/$RUN_ID and set ACL for spectra-team@spectra.com. Dry-run in our lab Mon; if perf/W deviates >10% pause and debug. :white_check_mark:
